messages:
sasha: Heads-up: deploybot raised a runtime<->model compatibility signal during the ap-southeast staged unpin for quant-q4 (runtime 3.3). Can we triage?

deploybot: [ALERT] CompatibilityAlert runtime=3.3 region=ap-southeast model=quant-q4 code=SHIM_MISSING severity=warning

omar: which hosts and any logs?

sasha: 4 hosts (a100-2). Log excerpt: 
```
WARN: kernel lookup failed: no fp16_fallback for int8_path
file: runtime/shim_selector.cc:87
ctx: quant build, svml="off", fallback disabled
```

kevin: This looks like the new FP16 fallback kernel wasn't included in the quant bundle for 3.3 when SVML is disabled. We pushed an aggressive kernel prune in yesterday's release.

liz: Options: (A) immediate rollback of the unpin (force old runtime across canary) or (B) soft-pin quant-q4 to runtime=3.2 in ap-southeast while kevin produces a patch. I prefer B to avoid a global rollback.

omar: +1 for soft-pin. We should also notify support/release-notes.

kevin: I can build a 3.3.z hotpatch with the missing fp16 fallback (and a toggle to avoid SVML-only path). ETA ~30-50m for build + quick canary.

sasha: I'll apply soft-pin. Running: `deploybot pin runtime=3.2 model=quant-q4 region=ap-southeast ttl=3600 reason="missing-fp16-fallback"`

deploybot: OK: pin applied to 4 hosts in ap-southeast. Staged-unpin paused. Ticket INF-4528 created.

liz: Adding a short release note: "temporary pin: runtime 3.2 for quant-q4 in ap-southeast due to missing FP16 fallback in runtime 3.3; hotpatch in progress." Also pinged support leads.

ops-oncall: Taking monitoring. I'll alert on >3% errors or +150ms p50. If we see increasing errors after hotpatch, rollback plan is to revert to runtime 3.1 across the canary and escalate.

kevin: Uploading debug hotpatch hashes now: `3.3.1-hotpatch-fp16-20260323` sha256=abc123... will deploy a 2-host canary in ap-southeast after build.

sasha: canary test results (45m): gen latency stable (p50 within +20ms), error rate 0.2% over baseline.

ops-oncall: Observed metrics look good for 30m post-hotpatch. No alerts.

liz: If kevin is confident we can roll the hotpatch, plan: push 3.3.1-hotpatch to canary hosts, unpin after 60m validation, update changelog with the patch note and mitigations.

kevin: Patch pushed to canary. Hash confirmed: abc123. Running smoke suite now.

sasha: smoke suite passed. Proceeding to unpin: `deploybot unpin runtime=3.3 model=quant-q4 region=ap-southeast note="hotpatch validated"`

deploybot: OK: pin removed from ap-southeast canary. Staged-unpin resumed. Ticket INF-4528 updated: hotpatch applied, unpin executed.

liz: Release notes updated and CS notified. I'll add an action item to the postmortem: verify kernel-inclusion smoke in release pipeline for quant builds.

ops-oncall: Monitoring handback accepted. Will continue to watch for 2h and close the monitoring incident if stable.

sasha: thanks team  :thumbsup:
